header: Nobody gets planned onto a shift they are not certified for
bodytext:
Every qualification your operation depends on — a first-aid certificate, a forklift licence, a food-safety course, the right to close alone — is held against the employee with its expiry date. A shift that requires one can only be filled by somebody who holds it, and the planner shows the reason rather than simply refusing.

Thirty days before a certificate expires, the holder and their manager both get a notice. The shift stays legal because somebody was told in time, not because a report was run afterwards.
quote_text: We used to keep the certificates in a lever-arch file and hope. Two months in, the system caught a forklift licence that had lapsed in February and had been planned on eleven times since.
author: Ruth Amsler
